reddit.title: Introducing New Features in Provincia: Let Your Colony Speak
reddit.body: We've made some exciting updates to Provincia that enhance your gameplay experience! Now, settlers display thought badges for their needs, work, and more, making it easier to understand their status at a glance. Plus, when issues arise, alerts will stack on the side of your screen, allowing you to address problems quickly without hunting through the grid. Check out our latest devtalk for a deeper dive into these features and how they can improve your colony management: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/when-the-colony-talks-back?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=when-the-colony-talks-back

steam.title: New Communication Features in Provincia!
steam.body: We're excited to share that Provincia has received significant updates! Your settlers will now sport thought badges that indicate their needs and tasks, and you'll receive real-time alerts for any issues that arise in your colony. This means you can manage your settlement more efficiently than ever before. For a detailed look at these features, visit our latest devtalk: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/when-the-colony-talks-back?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=when-the-colony-talks-back
